candidates.statement: Order service is returning HTTP 500s: 7 unhandled_request_failure ERROR logs, error_rate 0.16, p95 440ms, and ERROR checkout spans (1350ms) that propagate to gateway call-order ERROR spans (901ms). Payment and inventory are healthy, so the failure is localized to order.
candidates.uncertainty: Root defect inside order (code vs dependency) not yet isolated; db_pool_waiters and dependency_timeouts are 0, so pool exhaustion and downstream timeouts are not shown.

report.explanation: Current telemetry localizes the incident to the order service: elevated error_rate (0.16), p95 440ms, 7 HTTP 500 unhandled failures, and ERROR checkout spans propagating to gateway. Payment and inventory metrics are healthy and pool waiters/timeouts are zero. Deployment record alone does not establish causation. Root defect within order remains unisolated.
missing_evidence: Order service stack traces or exception details for the 7 unhandled_request_failure events to identify the failing code path
Order-to-postgresql query latency/error telemetry to rule out database-side causes
Order-to-payment and order-to-inventory call-level spans to confirm downstream calls succeed
